# RECORDED take folder: walk w-o7 (codex, codex-cli 0.162.1)

A byte-for-byte copy of the committed walk folder `rehearsals/w-o7/` (walk ref `walk/w-OMeE6P4y`, commit `68fff362c00ebbc88cec9df45b0a6a94ba5307e8`), with `evidence/` left out.
These files are records: they are never edited, masked or regenerated.
PROVENANCE.json names each file's source path, git blob id and sha256; tests/test_vendor_check.py (VP-provenance) re-reads every file against its source in the tree.
A firing case never edits this folder: tests/vendor_plant.py copies it to a scratch folder, plants one violation and re-binds the digests there.

Every file below is labelled in the form check_take._vendor_recorded_fixture_problem and the adapter tests' RECORDED_LABEL read.
